text:
Ava S.: tiny idea  Decluttering challenge: 'Adopt-a-Holiday-Thing'  if you have extra decorations (mini trees, lights, ornaments, battery candles) that you don't want to keep, drop them in the lobby box and people can adopt. free to a good desk. no judgement. :evergreen_tree:
Marcus Li: OMG yes. i have three half-used strings of lights that only one bulb works on. adopting these to someone who wants low-effort ambience. :bulb:
Jin Park: can i put a tiny disclaimer about pet-safe ornaments? my cat eats tinsel. also i can take a mini tree if it doesn't have glitter. :cat2:
Felix (they/them): i have an inflatable reindeer that lost an ear. perfect for office porch vibes if someone wants to DIY repair. :deer:
mailroom-bot: Drop-off location: Reception shelf "Adopt-a-Holiday-Thing". Mailroom hours: 9am-4pm. Please label items and include your slack handle for provenance (optional).
Ava S.: rules: 1) free to adopt, 2) tidy pick-up by Jan 10, 3) if you take something, say "claimed" in thread so others know.
Marcus Li: claimed (one strand of partially-lit lights)  thanks! i'll give it a new home near my fern. :herb:
Jin Park: claimed a glitter-free mini tree! thanks @Ava :sparkles: also adding a tip: battery candles are great for desks that don't like open flames.
Felix (they/them): posted a photo of the reindeer — https://imgur.com/a/example-deer repair ideas welcome. :hammer_and_wrench:
Ava S.: very small PSA: please sanitize ornaments if they're pre-loved. we have a box of sanitizing wipes by reception.
HR-bot: Reminder: items left longer than 30 days will be donated to local shelter. Redwood is not responsible for lost or damaged decorations.
Jin Park: tiny poll: should we do a "Holiday Repair Night" (glue guns + snacks) before Jan 5? thumbs up for yes. :yum:
mailroom-bot: Current inventory snapshot: 12 items (4 trees, 3 light strings, 2 boxes of ornaments, 1 inflatable, 2 battery candle sets).
Marcus Li: shoutout to whoever dropped off vintage tinsel, that looks fantastic. :sparkles:
Felix (they/them): small follow-up: if anyone wants the reindeer, dm me and i'll include a bag of spare batteries.
Ava S.: pairing idea: we could add a tiny "adoption note" tag with a message like "Enjoy! - previous desk elf". low-effort, high cheer.
Jin Park: love that. i'll bring tags tomorrow.
Marcus Li: also, can we have a micro contest for the "Most Unexpected Decoration"? winner gets a tiny chocolate. :chocolate_bar:
Ava S.: yes please. entry requirement: must be found in the adopt box. reveal on Jan 11. :tada:
Felix (they/them): claimed the "Most Unexpected" category in advance with my one-eared reindeer. fair warning.
Ava S.: thanks everyone! will post a final inventory update tomorrow. and happy holidays to folks heading out early " :snowman_with_snow: — be safe and cozy!"
